name: @raptor/bundle
description: RaptorBundle: bundler TSX/ESM propriu (zero-dep runtime). Transforma JSX -> @raptor/dom jsx-runtime, rezolva graful si impacheteaza intr-un singur fisier browser. Foloseste compilatorul TypeScript ca primitiva de transform (doar build-time), fara Vite/esbuild/Rolldown.
